title: Exposition
statementMd:
There are several days left before the fiftieth birthday of a famous Berland's writer Berlbury. In this connection the local library decided to make an exposition of the works of this famous science-fiction writer. It was decided as well that it is necessary to include into the exposition only those books that were published during a particular time period. It is obvious that if the books differ much in size, the visitors will not like it. That was why the organizers came to the opinion, that the difference between the highest and the lowest books in the exposition should be not more than $*k*$ millimeters.

The library has $*n*$ volumes of books by Berlbury, arranged in chronological order of their appearance. The height of each book in millimeters is know, it is $*h*_{*i*}$. As Berlbury is highly respected in the city, the organizers want to include into the exposition as many books as possible, and to find out what periods of his creative work they will manage to cover. You are asked to help the organizers cope with this hard task.

## Input

The first line of the input data contains two integer numbers separated by a space $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) and $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$) — the amount of books by Berlbury in the library, and the maximum allowed height difference between the lowest and the highest books. The second line contains $*n*$ integer numbers separated by a space. Each number $*h*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$) is the height of the $*i*$-th book in millimeters.

## Output

In the first line of the output data print two numbers $*a*$ and $*b*$ (separate them by a space), where $*a*$ is the maximum amount of books the organizers can include into the exposition, and $*b*$ — the amount of the time periods, during which Berlbury published $*a*$ books, and the height difference between the lowest and the highest among these books is not more than $*k*$ milllimeters.

In each of the following $*b*$ lines print two integer numbers separated by a space — indexes of the first and the last volumes from each of the required time periods of Berlbury's creative work.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
距离著名的别尔兰作家 Berlbury 的五十岁生日还有几天。为此，当地图书馆决定举办一场关于这位著名科幻作家作品的展览会。同时，图书馆还决定，展览会中只能展出在某一特定时期内出版的书籍。显然，如果这些书的尺寸相差太大，参观者会不喜欢。因此，组织者认为，展览会中最高的书与最低的书之间的高度差不应超过 $*k*$ 毫米。

图书馆有 $*n*$ 本 Berlbury 的作品，按照它们出版的时间顺序排列。每本书的高度（单位为毫米）已知，为 $*h*_{*i*}$。由于 Berlbury 在这座城市中备受尊敬，组织者希望尽可能多地将他的书纳入展览会，并找出他们能够涵盖的创作时期。请你帮助组织者完成这项艰巨的任务。

## 输入格式

输入数据的第一行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）和 $*k*$（$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$），分别表示图书馆中 Berlbury 的书籍数量，以及最低和最高书籍之间允许的最大高度差。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个由空格分隔的整数。每个数 $*h*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）表示第 $*i*$ 本书的高度，单位为毫米。

## 输出格式

输出数据的第一行输出两个数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（用空格分隔），其中 $*a*$ 是组织者能够纳入展览会的最大书籍数量，$*b*$ 是 Berlbury 出版 $*a*$ 本书、且这些书中最高书籍与最低书籍的高度差不超过 $*k*$ 毫米的时间段数量。

接下来的 $*b*$ 行中，每行输出两个由空格分隔的整数，表示每个所需创作时期中第一本和最后一本书的编号。
</statement>
